note: Roadmap P3 (D-P3-A..G): two declarative per-agent adapters (EXPERIMENTAL) plus the DECLARED generic fallback. Adapters remain optional and disposable; the core must pass with every adapter deleted (exercised by sps2/tools/test-portability.py). Each entry has an equal declarative mirror at core/adapters/<agent_id>/adapter.json.

fallbacks.structured_questions: Use plain conversational questions and record the answer in project state.
fallbacks.subagents: Execute sequentially in the primary agent.
fallbacks.browser: Record verification as NOT RUN rather than claiming success.
